Name: mia-db-password-rotated
Description: Chunk C9: intended to fire when the RDS-managed secret finishes rotating the master password, so mia-db-password-sync can push it to mia/prod. detail-type is AWS Service Event via CloudTrail because Secrets Manager rotation completion is a service-emitted event, not an API call. UNVERIFIED: this exact pattern has never been fired by a real rotation -- confirm eventName and where the secret id actually lives (likely additionalEventData, not requestParameters, for a service event) against AWS docs and one real staging rotation before relying on it. Do not deploy on the assumption it fires.
